rows.abstract: \"Express Lane Act of 2004.\" The bill mandates all government institutions to establish an express lane to facilitate the delivery of services in the most convenient, fast and reliable manner. rows.abstract: To uphold civilian supremacy over the military, the bill seeks to prohibit former military officers from being appointed as Secretary of National Defense within three years after relief from active duty as a commissioned officer the Armed Forces of the Philippines.

rows.abstract: The bill seeks to redefine the term \"veteran\" by restricting its application to those who rendered military service in the Armed Forces of the Philippines and have been honorably discharged or separated after a total of at least 20 years cumulative service, instead of the original requirement of only six years.

rows.abstract: The bill authorizes the Treasurer of the Philippines to issue to veterans Certificates of Indebtedness in payment of arrearages in their pensions. The certificates may be used as payment for goods and services such as rice from National Food Authority, real estate taxes, tuition fees, amortization of housing loans, utility bills, among others.

rows.abstract: \"Improved Qualifications Act of 2004.\" The bill aims to require all persons seeking to run for an elective public office to undergo a neuro-psychiatric examination and to attach the result of thereof to his certificate of candidacy.

The reduced share of the HEDF shall be reallocated to the Philippine Tourism Authority to be used for tourism infrastructure development and promotions.
